# HRPro | Product Overview

HRPro is an integrated personnel and remuneration system for Hong Kong companies, emphasizing local remuneration, MPF, taxation and optional AI support. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
